title: Esoteric Ebb
notes: Launched through Proton-ish 1.0.7 (Steam compat tool using the Highball engine), not through the Highball app/CLI, so there is no `highball report` output. The version above is HighballKit 0.10.22 from the launch log. Played about 3.5 hours over two sessions (~1h45m + ~1h40m), through several areas (Viskens Lair, Goblin Garden, Tolstad, all on Day 1). Both sessions exited cleanly and autosaves worked. No settings changed from the defaults (DXMT, msync off, AVX advertised). Player.log shows only two harmless warnings: "DBufferClear shader is not supported on this GPU" and "Failed to create ID3D11Fence"; nothing visible on screen. Setup note: on a clean Mac without Rosetta 2 this setup initially failed with "OS Error 0" (Bad CPU type in executable); it worked after installing Rosetta 2. This was reported in https://github.com/MagnusPladsen/Proton-ish/issues/61 and fixed in Proton-ish 1.0.12/1.0.13: a launch without Rosetta now stops with a clear message, the Status page warns when Rosetta 2 is missing, and a prefix left over from a failed launch is re-seeded.
